mitre_attck_mapping.evidence: The malware enumerates running processes and expresses interest in a large number of them (observed for PIDs 5172 and 6540, including System, Registry, smss.exe, csrss.exe, wininit.exe, etc.).

The binary employs obfuscation techniques through software packing, as evidenced by unknown PE section names (.nsp0, .nsp1, .nsp2, .vmp0), high entropy regions, and specific identification of NsPack and VMProtect packers.

The binary exhibits multiple indicators of software packing, including unknown PE section names (.nsp0, .nsp1, .nsp2, .vmp0), high entropy in sections (.nsp1, .vmp0), and specific identification as packed with NsPack and VMProtect, confirmed by YARA rules.
